races.display_title: Buckley Agri New Holland Irish EBF Mares Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict: Only a handful are of any real interest, with LENNON GROVE 's second in a Grade 2 mares bumper at Aintree in the spring catching the eye and she's taken to make a winning start over hurdles. The Besty Woman seems to be getting better with racing and is entitled to be in the mix, with Al Arrivee another threat providing this doesn't turn into a speed test. LENNON GROVE (IRE) THE BESTY WOMAN (IRE) AL ARRIVEE (FR)

races.verdict: GIVE IT A CRACK was placed on both starts in points, is in excellent hands and looks to have been found a winnable opportunity on hurdles debut. Course bumper winner Tell The Boys was well fancied when failing to complete on hurdling debut and may prove the main threat, while Coolishael and Rokanako bring the best previous form and are also capable of being involved. GIVE IT A CRACK TELL THE BOYS (IRE) COOLISHAEL (IRE)

races.display_title: Thorn Plant Hire Beginners Chase
races.verdict: A cracking beginners chase. The vote goes to LOVE ME TENDER , who finished with running left when fourth on his chasing debut at the Galway Festival and the youngest of Willie Mullins' quartet seems sure to improve for that initial experience. Fort Dino left his chasing debut form well behind when runner-up at Killarney 5 weeks ago so heads up the threats, with I Will Be Baie and Largy Hill both adding another layer of intrigue returning from significant absences. LOVE ME TENDER (FR) FORT DINO (FR) I WILL BE BAIE (FR)

races.verdict: A case can be made for a few of these but the vote goes to RENEWABLE DREAM who took a step forward for his new handler when running on into third at Wolverhampton (form been well advertised since) and can gain a first win now returned to 1m here. Ocean Force rates a big danger if, as expected, proving better suited to this track than when sixth at Lingfield last time. C&D scorer Starakova and handicap debutante Roccapina are other likely players too in this competitive handicap. RENEWABLE DREAM OCEAN FORCE (IRE) STARAKOVA

races.display_title: Follow AtTheRaces On X Nursery
races.verdict: This is wide open. EEVEE STAR showed the benefit of blinkers when a resurgent fourth at Newcastle last time and eased 1 lb here, she can gain a breakthrough victory with the step up to 7f and the services of Billy Loughnane both likely positives. Richard Hannon's From Me To You advanced his form when third at Wolverhampton and heads the list of dangers off a handy-looking mark, while Claret And Blues and No More Pino can play a prominent role too. EEVEE STAR FROM ME TO YOU (IRE) CLARET AND BLUES
